notablePrerequisites: Mairsil does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Mairsil using Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Mairsil using Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping Mairsil.
Activate Mairsil using Mirage Mirror's ability by paying {2}, causing Mairsil to become a copy of itself until end of turn.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may also activate Chromatic Orrery's second ability and/or any of Staff of Domination's other abilities each loop.
